title: 初始化、身份、GETCO 与 runtime closeout
physical_meaning: A replay batch must bind 1-6 analyzers to SN/device_code, protocol ID, GETCO1-9, and neutral runtime state.
next_action: Bind a concrete historical or future batch initialization closeout artifact; do not infer identity from route files.

title: 压力/S9 no-write、写入读回与复验
physical_meaning: Pressure must be traceable before gas or water fitting so S1-S4 do not absorb pressure bias.
next_action: Bind per-device mature pressure evidence, including any explicit linear-S9 exception and post-write reverify.

title: 0613/0620/0621 成熟入口与连续 route 根
physical_meaning: The queue and point-internal route contract may pass while the historical evidence still lacks one continuous mature run root.
next_action: Keep the mature runners unchanged; bind one fresh continuous queue root rather than promoting segmented or recovery evidence.

title: 旧算法成熟 CO2 45 点
physical_meaning: A 45-point accepted composite can support diagnosis but cannot prove that one continuous mature queue completed.
next_action: Use one continuous 45-point mature queue for production; keep the historical composite diagnostic-only.

title: 旧算法成熟 H2O 13 湿点
physical_meaning: Segmented wet points are not equivalent to one mature 13-point H2O queue, and CO2 zero gas is not an interchangeable H2O dry-gas anchor.
next_action: Bind one continuous mature 13-point H2O root with component-matched QC and separately traceable dry-gas anchor evidence.

title: component-QC 与 0613 多策略 no-write 拟合
physical_meaning: Fitting must consume per-analyzer physical QC and the 0613 strategy rules, not merely all available points.
next_action: Bind a continuous mature 45/13 route root and separate H2O dry-gas anchor evidence, then rerun the now-available no-write matrix.

title: 系数受控写入与 GETCO 读回
physical_meaning: Calculation, authorization, old-value snapshot, write, and readback are separate evidence events.
next_action: Close the unified S1-S9/SENCOA-B controlled-write bundle without treating a successful write as a successful validation.

title: 写后独立短复验
physical_meaning: Readback proves stored bytes; independent reverify proves the physical calibration result.
next_action: Bind component-specific short reverify evidence after every authorized write before archive closure.

title: 归档、release 与 PostgreSQL 18 受控入库
physical_meaning: Database import is the last transaction after traceable archive release, never a side effect of route, fitting, replay, or coefficient writing.
next_action: Implement the controlled PostgreSQL 18 transaction only after archive, identity, readback, and reverify evidence close.
